name: Amanaya Ventures Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2009, Amanaya Ventures 
Ltd does trading of Commodities and Securities, and also provides Corporate Advisory Services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
a) AVL is in the business of Trading of Precious Metals i.e. 24 Carat Gold, Silver Bars & Jewellery. It focuses on spot buying and selling of physical 24 Carat gold and silver bars. Company has developed the 24 carat gold and silver bars under its own  brand name Aurel with different denominations and sizes
b) Company is providing Corporate Advisory as well as trading of the commodities and securities

pros: Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 54.6 days to 37.6 days
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 3.46% over last 3 years.
